description: This Java class implements the DefaultMetricsConfig for managing metrics configuration in the Eclipse Ditto project. It reads configuration values related to metrics, Prometheus settings, and provides accessors and overridden methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultMetricsConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of MetricsConfig that loads and provides access to metrics-related configuration settings, including Prometheus configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultMetricsConfig from a given Config object, using a specific config path.

methods.name: isSystemMetricsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether system metrics are enabled as per the configuration.

methods.name: isPrometheusEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether Prometheus metrics are enabled as per the configuration.

methods.name: getPrometheusHostname
methods.description: Returns the Prometheus hostname from the configuration.

methods.name: getPrometheusPort
methods.description: Returns the Prometheus port from the configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare configuration instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode for the configuration instance.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration object.
